objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Exploit the server-side template injection weakness of a Flask loan calculator (Apache mod_wsgi) with a MySQL 5.7 database and read the flag in /flag.
hints: Find the input that ends up inside the template source rather than being passed to it as data.
Find where a request path or parameter is mapped onto the file system.

steps.prompt: Which vulnerability class lets your input be evaluated by the template engine?

steps.prompt: Which template engine renders the included templates?
